item.title: The Future Is for Everyone: Meta and CNIB Partner to Support Canadians Who Are Blind, Deafblind or Have Low Vision
item.description: We believe the future is for everyone. That’s why Meta is partnering with CNIB – a non-profit founded in 1918 that empowers Canadians impacted by blindness to live their dreams – to help bring the benefit of AI glasses to more Canadians who are blind, Deafblind or have low vision. The goal of the partnership is to help people who are blind, Deafblind or have low vision explore the possibilities of AI wearable technology, and draw on the knowledge, expertise and lived experience of the community （Meta AI / Muse Newsroom）

item.title: OpenRouter 实测 13 种提示注入攻击，讲解 Armor 与 Guardrails 防御方法 / How to Prevent Prompt Injection: 13 Attacks, Tested
item.description: If your app has a model read documents, emails or web pages, anyone who writes in them can try to give it instructions. We ran 25 attacks against four current models with each defense on and off. Labels cut attack emails, but only checking every tool call with Armor stopped all of them.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: 404 Media 起底 Proton 内部 AI 转型之争：CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 引发恐惧文化 / Manifestos, Fear, and ‘Loser Thinking’: Inside Proton’s AI Reckoning
item.description: 404 Media 采访九名现任与离职 Proton 员工并查阅内部文件，报道 CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 转型引发的内部冲突。10 月公司 90% 代码由 AI 编写，多使用 Anthropic 的 Claude；Yen 称今年是最后一年招聘工程师，并宣布将以可能决定去留的重新面试评估员工 AI 使用情况。（404 Media（RSS））

item.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 LLM 从 PDF 中抽取表格 / How to Extract Tables from a PDF with an LLM
item.description: Send a PDF to a model that reads files, with a strict JSON schema for one row, and you get typed rows back, even from scans and tables that run across pages. We tested five routes on five PDFs and found two failures that return a normal response with no error, and the checks that catch them.（OpenRouter Blog）
